statuses.active: Current within the document's responsibility; only gameplay owners establish game rules.
statuses.draft: Unaccepted work in progress; excluded from active routes and rule dependencies.
statuses.deferred: Postponed proposal; excluded from active routes and rule dependencies.
statuses.deprecated: Retired or rejected design retained for provenance; not current authority.
statuses.superseded_contextual: Historical record replaced by current owners; contextual use only.
